description.value: Mattone Italian Kitchen is a family-owned modern Italian restaurant perched at Salmon Point Resort on the Salish Sea, offering a 180-degree oceanfront view along the Old Island Highway near Campbell River. The kitchen is led by chef Ryan Gark, a Chopped Canada champion, and his wife Katrina, whose Italian family roots inform the menu of house-made pasta, fresh local seafood, and daily-baked focaccia. Touring cyclists passing through on the Old Island Highway will find a welcoming casual counter-service stop with a locally sourced menu.

address.value: 2176 Salmon Point Road, Campbell River, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business name, address (2176 Salmon Point Road, Campbell River, BC), and phone number matching OSM. The menu page explicitly labels items with (GF), (GFO), and (VO) tags confirming dietary options, and the oyster bar section states 'NOT AVAILABLE FOR TAKEOUT' implying takeout is available for other items. No evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities. A discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (Th-Mo) and the website (Th-Su, closed Monday), and the URL discovery notes flag a possible duplicate OSM node.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Th-Mo (includes Monday) but the website explicitly states 'CLOSED MONDAY - WEDNESDAY + ALL STATUTORY HOLIDAYS', indicating Monday is closed. OSM hours appear incorrect.
URL discovery notes flag a possible duplicate OSM node at the same address (aa89cff896). The two OSM records should be checked for consolidation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating waterfront restaurant with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and a full menu — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists on the Old Island Highway.
